plan.notes: Recommended Course Sequence published on catalog pp. 264-266 of the official 2023-2024 catalog; Certificate of Achievement in Transfer Studies: IGETC (Intersegmental General Education Transfer Curriculum for UC/CSU transfer). The certificate requires a minimum of 37 transferable units; the recommended sequence totals 44 at the lower bound. ENGL 5 requires ENGL 1A. Footnote 1: HIST 7A/HIST 7B must be taken at College of Alameda for the IGETC area. Footnote 2: Oral Communication (COMM 45) is required for CSU transfer only; Language Other Than English (SPAN 1A) is required for UC transfer only. This is a transfer-pattern certificate; transfer_confidence is core_only. Computed total 44. Revalidated 2026-10-01 against the official College of Alameda 2024-2025 catalog (CoA-Catalog-24-25_PRINT_v1.pdf, 7,590,937 bytes, 416 pages; live alameda.edu copy 404s, retrieved via Wayback Machine capture 20250808180750): recommended course sequence verified identical to the 2023-2024 transcription. The 2025-2026 catalog is published only on Curriqunet (JS-rendered, no downloadable PDF); revalidation against it is pending a live-browser pass. 2026-2027 revalidation (2026-10-01): the live College of Alameda catalog is now 2026-2027 (Curriqunet, module 10507); it no longer lists this certificate. The CSU GE Breadth and IGETC certificates were superseded by the singular Cal-GETC transfer pathway effective Fall 2025 (catalog 'California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC)' page). This seed's 2024-2025 label remains honest — the program and its sequence were verified against the official 2024-2025 catalog PDF.
